{{Top|leg|title=j'ber Jer'N}}
'''J'ber Jer'N''' was a [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] [[j'ber]]. In the years following [[Se'Lenti|the Scouring]], the family emerged as the premier weaponsmiths on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] with their company, [[Jer'N Weapons Systems]].
